summary: Makes the annotated lambda function implement java.io.Serializable, generates a pretty toString implementation and adds reflection metadata.

name: kotlin.jvm.JvmStatic
summary: Specifies that an additional static method needs to be generated from this element if it's a function. If this element is a property, additional static getter/setter methods should be generated.

name: kotlin.jvm.JvmSuppressWildcards
summary: Instructs compiler to generate or omit wildcards for type arguments corresponding to parameters with declaration-site variance, for example such as Collection<out T> has.

name: kotlin.jvm.JvmSynthetic
summary: Sets ACC_SYNTHETIC flag on the annotated target in the Java bytecode.

name: kotlin.jvm.JvmWildcard
summary: Instructs compiler to generate wildcard for annotated type arguments corresponding to parameters with declaration-site variance.

name: kotlin.reflect.KAnnotatedElement
summary: Represents an annotated element and allows to obtain its annotations. See the Kotlin language documentation for more information.

name: kotlin.reflect.KCallable
summary: Represents a callable entity, such as a function or a property.

name: kotlin.reflect.KClass
summary: Represents a class and provides introspection capabilities. Instances of this class are obtainable by the ::class syntax. See the Kotlin language documentation for more information.

name: kotlin.reflect.KClassifier
summary: A classifier is either a class or a type parameter.

name: kotlin.reflect.KDeclarationContainer
summary: Represents an entity which may contain declarations of any other entities, such as a class or a package.

name: kotlin.reflect.KFunction
summary: Represents a function with introspection capabilities.

name: kotlin.reflect.KMutableProperty
summary: Represents a property declared as a var.

name: kotlin.reflect.KMutableProperty0
summary: Represents a var-property without any kind of receiver.

name: kotlin.reflect.KMutableProperty1
summary: Represents a var-property, operations on which take one receiver as a parameter.

name: kotlin.reflect.KMutableProperty2
summary: Represents a var-property, operations on which take two receivers as parameters.

name: kotlin.KotlinVersion
summary: Represents a version of the Kotlin standard library.

name: kotlin.reflect.KParameter
summary: Represents a parameter passed to a function or a property getter/setter, including this and extension receiver parameters.

name: kotlin.reflect.KProperty
summary: Represents a property, such as a named val or var declaration. Instances of this class are obtainable by the :: operator.

name: kotlin.reflect.KProperty0
summary: Represents a property without any kind of receiver. Such property is either originally declared in a receiverless context such as a package, or has the receiver bound to it.

name: kotlin.reflect.KProperty1
summary: Represents a property, operations on which take one receiver as a parameter.

name: kotlin.reflect.KProperty2
summary: Represents a property, operations on which take two receivers as parameters, such as an extension property declared in a class.

name: kotlin.reflect.KType
summary: Represents a type. Type is usually either a class with optional type arguments, or a type parameter of some declaration, plus nullability.

name: kotlin.reflect.KTypeParameter
summary: Represents a declaration of a type parameter of a class or a callable. See the Kotlin language documentation for more information.

name: kotlin.reflect.KTypeProjection
summary: Represents a type projection. Type projection is usually the argument to another type in a type usage. For example, in the type Array<out Number>, out Number is the covariant projection of the type represented by the class Number.

name: kotlin.reflect.KVariance
summary: Represents variance applied to a type parameter on the declaration site (declaration-site variance), or to a type in a projection (use-site variance).

name: kotlin.reflect.KVisibility
summary: Visibility is an aspect of a Kotlin declaration regulating where that declaration is accessible in the source code. Visibility can be changed with one of the following modifiers: public, protected, internal, private.

name: kotlin.Lazy
summary: Represents a value with lazy initialization.

name: kotlin.LazyThreadSafetyMode
summary: Specifies how a Lazy instance synchronizes initialization and publication among multiple threads. On platforms with no notion of synchronization and threads (JS and WASM), all modes are considered equal to the default implementation.

name: kotlin.collections.LinkedHashMap
summary: A hash table implementation of MutableMap that maintains insertion order.

name: kotlin.collections.LinkedHashSet
summary: A hash table implementation of MutableSet that maintains insertion order.

name: kotlin.collections.List
summary: A generic ordered collection of elements. The interface allows iterating over contained elements, accessing elements by index, checking if a list contains some elements, and searching indices for particular values. Complex operations are built upon this functionality and provided in form of kotlin.collections extension functions.

name: kotlin.collections.ListIterator
summary: An iterator over a collection that supports indexed access.

name: kotlin.Long
summary: Represents a 64-bit signed integer.

name: kotlin.LongArray
summary: An array of longs. When targeting the JVM, instances of this class are represented as long[].

name: kotlin.collections.LongIterator
summary: An iterator over a sequence of values of type Long.

name: kotlin.ranges.LongProgression
summary: A progression of values of type Long.

name: kotlin.ranges.LongRange
summary: A range of values of type Long.

name: kotlin.collections.Map
summary: A collection that holds pairs of objects (keys and values) and supports retrieving the value corresponding to each key, checking if a collection holds a particular key or a value. Maps also allow iterating over keys, values or key-value pairs (entries). Complex operations are built upon this functionality and provided in form of kotlin.collections extension functions.

name: kotlin.text.MatchGroup
summary: Represents the results from a single capturing group within a MatchResult of Regex.

name: kotlin.text.MatchGroupCollection
summary: Represents a collection of captured groups in a single match of a regular expression.

name: kotlin.text.MatchNamedGroupCollection
summary: Extends MatchGroupCollection by introducing a way to get matched groups by name, when regex supports it.

name: kotlin.text.MatchResult
summary: Represents the results from a single regular expression match.

name: kotlin.wasm.unsafe.MemoryAllocator
summary: WebAssembly linear memory allocator.

name: kotlin.native.MemoryModel
summary: Memory model.

name: kotlin.native.runtime.MemoryUsage
summary: This class represents statistics of memory usage in one memory pool.

name: kotlin.Metadata
summary: This annotation is present on any class file produced by the Kotlin compiler and is read by the compiler and reflection. Parameters have very short JVM names on purpose: these names appear in all generated class files, and we'd like to reduce their size.

name: kotlin.annotation.MustBeDocumented
summary: This meta-annotation determines that an annotation is a part of public API and therefore should be included in the generated documentation for the element to which the annotation is applied.

name: kotlin.MustUseReturnValues
summary: Marks the scope (file or class) in which all the functions are non-ignorable. Kotlin's return value checker would report a warning in case the result of a non-ignorable function call is not used.

name: kotlin.collections.MutableCollection
summary: A generic collection of elements that supports iterating, adding and removing elements, as well as checking if the collection contains some elements. Complex operations are built upon this functionality and provided in form of kotlin.collections extension functions.

name: kotlin.native.concurrent.MutableData
summary: Mutable concurrently accessible data buffer. Could be accessed from several workers simultaneously.

name: kotlin.collections.MutableIterable
summary: Classes that inherit from this interface can be represented as a sequence of elements that can be iterated over and that supports removing elements during iteration.

name: kotlin.collections.MutableIterator
summary: An iterator over a mutable collection. Provides the ability to remove elements while iterating.

name: kotlin.collections.MutableList
summary: A generic ordered collection of elements that supports adding, replacing and removing elements, as well as iterating over contained elements, accessing them by an index and checking if a collection contains a particular value.

name: kotlin.collections.MutableListIterator
summary: An iterator over a mutable collection that supports indexed access. Provides the ability to add, modify and remove elements while iterating.

name: kotlin.collections.MutableMap
summary: A collection that holds pairs of objects (keys and values) and supports retrieving the value corresponding to each key, as well as adding new, removing or updating existing pairs.

name: kotlin.collections.MutableSet
summary: A generic unordered collection of unique elements that supports adding and removing elements, iterating over them and checking if a collection contains a particular value.

name: kotlin.js.nativeInvoke
summary: Marks a member function of an external declaration as the "invoke operator" of a JavaScript object. Every call to this function will be translated into a call of the object itself.

name: kotlin.native.runtime.NativeRuntimeApi
summary: This annotation marks the Kotlin/Native standard library API that tweaks or otherwise accesses the Kotlin runtime behavior.

name: kotlin.native.NoInline
summary: Forbids inlining of this function/property with the dedicated K/N inliner. Note: this has nothing to do with the inline keyword, it's a separate inlining phase meant for optimizations. The function/property still could be inlined by LLVM though.

name: kotlin.io.NoSuchFileException
summary: An exception class which is used when file to copy does not exist.

name: kotlin.Nothing
summary: Nothing has no instances. You can use Nothing to represent "a value that never exists": for example, if a function has the return type of Nothing, it means that it never returns (always throws an exception).

name: kotlin.NotImplementedError
summary: An exception is thrown to indicate that a method body remains to be implemented.

name: kotlin.Number
summary: Superclass for all platform classes representing numeric values.

name: kotlin.native.ObjCEnum
summary: Instructs the Kotlin compiler to generate a NS_ENUM typedef for the annotated enum class. The name of the generated type will be the name of the enum type with "NSEnum" appended. This name can be overridden with the "name" parameter, which is treated as an exact name. Additionally, a separate name for Swift can be specified using the swiftName parameter. For Objective-C, the enum literals will always be prefixed with the type name, always capitalizing the first character of the entry name, regardless whether they are implied or set explicitly via ObjCName or EntryName, as they live in a global namespace. For Swift, no such disambiguation prefixes will be added. The NSEnum values are accessible via the "nsEnum" property.

name: kotlin.native.ObjCName
summary: Instructs the Kotlin compiler to use a custom Objective-C and/or Swift name for this class, property, parameter or function.

name: kotlin.properties.ObservableProperty
summary: Implements the core logic of a property delegate for a read/write property that calls callback functions when changed.

name: kotlin.native.ObsoleteNativeApi
summary: This annotation marks the Kotlin/Native standard library API that is considered obsolete and is being phased out.

name: kotlin.native.concurrent.ObsoleteWorkersApi
summary: Marks all Worker-related API as obsolete.

name: kotlin.io.OnErrorAction
summary: Enum that can be used to specify behaviour of the copyRecursively() function in exceptional conditions.

name: kotlin.io.path.OnErrorResult
summary: The result of the onError function passed to Path.copyToRecursively that specifies further actions when an exception occurs.

name: kotlin.ranges.OpenEndRange
summary: Represents a range of values (for example, numbers or characters) where the upper bound is not included in the range. See the Kotlin language documentation for more information.

name: kotlin.OptIn
summary: Allows to use the API denoted by the given markers in the annotated file, declaration, or expression. If a declaration is annotated with OptIn, its usages are not required to opt in to that API.

name: kotlin.OptionalExpectation
summary: Marks an expected annotation class that it isn't required to have actual counterparts in all platforms.

name: kotlin.native.OsFamily
summary: Operating system family.

name: kotlin.OverloadResolutionByLambdaReturnType
summary: Enables overload selection based on the type of the value returned from lambda argument.

name: kotlin.Pair
summary: Represents a generic pair of two values.

name: kotlin.ParameterName
summary: Annotates type arguments of functional type and holds corresponding parameter name specified by the user in type declaration (if any).

name: kotlin.io.path.PathWalkOption
summary: An enumeration to provide walk options for the Path.walk function. The options can be combined to form the desired walk order and behavior.

name: kotlin.native.Platform
summary: Object describing the current platform program executes upon.

name: kotlin.wasm.unsafe.Pointer
summary: Linear memory pointer type. Corresponds to i32 type on 32-bit Wasm architecture.

name: kotlin.js.Promise
summary: Exposes the JavaScript Promise object to Kotlin.

name: kotlin.properties.PropertyDelegateProvider
summary: Base interface that can be used for implementing property delegate providers.

name: kotlin.PublishedApi
summary: When applied to a class or a member with internal visibility allows using it from public inline functions and makes it effectively public.

name: kotlin.jvm.PurelyImplements
summary: Instructs the Kotlin compiler to treat annotated Java class as pure implementation of given Kotlin interface. "Pure" means here that each type parameter of class becomes non-platform type argument of that interface.

name: kotlin.random.Random
summary: An abstract class that is implemented by random number generator algorithms.

name: kotlin.collections.RandomAccess
summary: Marker interface indicating that the List implementation supports fast indexed access.

name: kotlin.properties.ReadOnlyProperty
summary: Base interface that can be used for implementing property delegates of read-only properties.

name: kotlin.properties.ReadWriteProperty
summary: Base interface that can be used for implementing property delegates of read-write properties.

name: kotlin.native.RefinesInSwift
summary: Meta-annotation that instructs the Kotlin compiler to mark the annotated function or property as swift_private in the generated Objective-C API.

name: kotlin.text.Regex
summary: Represents a compiled regular expression. Provides functions to match strings in text with a pattern, replace the found occurrences and split text around matches.

name: kotlin.text.RegexOption
summary: Provides enumeration values to use to set regular expression options.

name: kotlin.js.RegExp
summary: Exposes the JavaScript RegExp object to Kotlin.

name: kotlin.js.RegExpMatch
summary: Represents the return value of RegExp.exec.

name: kotlin.annotation.Repeatable
summary: This meta-annotation determines that an annotation is applicable twice or more on a single code element

name: kotlin.ReplaceWith
summary: Specifies a code fragment that can be used to replace a deprecated function, property or class. Tools such as IDEs can automatically apply the replacements specified through this annotation.

name: kotlin.native.ReportUnhandledExceptionHook
summary: Typealias describing custom exception reporting hook.

name: kotlin.RequiresOptIn
summary: Signals that the annotated annotation class is a marker of an API that requires an explicit opt-in.

name: kotlin.coroutines.RestrictsSuspension
summary: Classes and interfaces marked with this annotation are restricted when used as receivers for extension suspend functions. These suspend extensions can only invoke other member or extension suspend functions on this particular receiver and are restricted from calling arbitrary suspension functions.

name: kotlin.Result
summary: A discriminated union that encapsulates a successful outcome with a value of type T or a failure with an arbitrary Throwable exception.

name: kotlin.annotation.Retention
summary: This meta-annotation determines whether an annotation is stored in binary output and visible for reflection. By default, both are true.

name: kotlin.contracts.Returns
summary: Describes a situation when a function returns normally with a given return value.

name: kotlin.contracts.ReturnsNotNull
summary: Describes a situation when a function returns normally with any non-null return value.

name: kotlin.native.runtime.RootSetStatistics
summary: This class represents statistics of the root set for garbage collector run, separated by root set pools. These nodes are assumed to be used, even if there are no references for them.

name: kotlin.sequences.Sequence
summary: A sequence that returns values through its iterator. The values are evaluated lazily, and the sequence is potentially infinite.

name: kotlin.sequences.SequenceScope
summary: The scope for yielding values of a Sequence or an Iterator, provides yield and yieldAll suspension functions.

name: kotlin.collections.Set
summary: A generic unordered collection of unique elements. The interface allows checking if an element is contained by it and iterating over all elements. Complex operations are built upon this functionality and provided in form of kotlin.collections extension functions.

name: kotlin.native.concurrent.SharedImmutable
summary: This annotation has no effect, and its usages can be safely dropped.

name: kotlin.Short
summary: Represents a 16-bit signed integer.

name: kotlin.ShortArray
summary: An array of shorts. When targeting the JVM, instances of this class are represented as short[].

name: kotlin.collections.ShortIterator
summary: An iterator over a sequence of values of type Short.

name: kotlin.native.ShouldRefineInSwift
summary: Instructs the Kotlin compiler to mark this function or property as swift_private in the generated Objective-C API.

name: kotlin.contracts.SimpleEffect
summary: An effect that can be observed after a function invocation.

name: kotlin.SinceKotlin
summary: Specifies the first version of Kotlin where a declaration has appeared. Using the declaration and specifying an older API version (via the -api-version command line option) will result in an error.

name: kotlin.jvm.Strictfp
summary: Marks the JVM method generated from the annotated function as strictfp, meaning that the precision of floating point operations performed inside the method needs to be restricted in order to achieve better portability.

name: kotlin.String
summary: The String class represents character strings. All string literals in Kotlin programs, such as "abc", are implemented as instances of this class.

name: kotlin.text.StringBuilder
summary: A mutable sequence of characters.

name: kotlin.SubclassOptInRequired
summary: Annotation that marks open for subclassing classes and interfaces, and makes implementation and extension of such declarations as requiring an explicit opt-in.

name: kotlin.Suppress
summary: Suppresses the given compilation warnings in the annotated element.

name: kotlin.coroutines.SuspendFunction
summary: Represents a value of a functional type, such as a lambda, an anonymous function or a function reference.

name: kotlin.native.runtime.SweepStatistics
summary: This class represents statistics of sweeping in one memory pool.

name: kotlin.native.SymbolName
summary: This is a dangerous deprecated and internal annotation. Please avoid using it.

name: kotlin.jvm.Synchronized
summary: Marks the JVM method generated from the annotated function as synchronized, meaning that the method will be protected from concurrent execution by multiple threads by the monitor of the instance (or, for static methods, the class) on which the method is defined.

name: kotlin.annotation.Target
summary: This meta-annotation indicates the kinds of code elements which are possible targets of an annotation.

name: kotlin.time.TestTimeSource
summary: A time source that has programmatically updatable readings. It is useful as a predictable source of time in tests.

name: kotlin.native.concurrent.ThreadLocal
summary: Marks a top level property with a backing field or an object as thread local. The object remains mutable and it is possible to change its state, but every thread will have a distinct copy of this object, so changes in one thread are not reflected in another.

name: kotlin.Throwable
summary: The base class for all errors and exceptions. Only instances of this class can be thrown or caught.

name: kotlin.Throws
summary: This annotation indicates what exceptions should be declared by a function when compiled to a platform method in Kotlin/JVM and Kotlin/Native.

name: kotlin.jvm.Throws
summary: This annotation indicates what exceptions should be declared by a function when compiled to a JVM method.

name: kotlin.time.TimedValue
summary: Data class representing a result of executing an action, along with the duration of the elapsed time interval.

name: kotlin.time.TimeMark
summary: Represents a time point notched on a particular TimeSource. Remains bound to the time source it was taken from and allows querying for the duration of time elapsed from that point (see the function elapsedNow).

name: kotlin.time.TimeSource
summary: A source of time for measuring time intervals.

name: kotlin.native.concurrent.TransferMode
summary: Note: modern Kotlin/Native memory manager allows to share objects between threads without additional ceremonies, so TransferMode has effect only in legacy memory manager.

name: kotlin.jvm.Transient
summary: Marks the backing field of the annotated property with the transient modifier on the JVM platform, meaning that it is not a part of the serialized form of the object when serialized with java.io.Serializable machinery.

name: kotlin.Triple
summary: Represents a triad of values

name: kotlin.text.Typography
summary: Defines names for Unicode symbols used in proper Typography.

name: kotlin.ranges.UIntProgression
summary: A progression of values of type UInt.

name: kotlin.ranges.UIntRange
summary: A range of values of type UInt.

name: kotlin.ranges.ULongProgression
summary: A progression of values of type ULong.

name: kotlin.ranges.ULongRange
summary: A range of values of type ULong.

name: kotlin.Unit
summary: The type with only one value: the Unit object. This type corresponds to the void type in Java.

name: kotlin.UnsafeVariance
summary: Suppresses errors about variance conflict

name: kotlin.wasm.unsafe.UnsafeWasmMemoryApi
summary: This annotation marks APIs for working with unmanaged WebAssembly linear memory.

name: kotlin.uuid.Uuid
summary: Represents a Universally Unique Identifier (UUID), also known as a Globally Unique Identifier (GUID).

name: kotlin.jvm.Volatile
summary: Marks the JVM backing field of the annotated var property as volatile, meaning that reads and writes to this field are atomic and writes are always made visible to other threads. If another thread reads the value of this field (e.g. through its accessor), it sees not only that value, but all side effects that led to writing that value.

name: kotlin.concurrent.Volatile
summary: Marks the backing field of the annotated var property as volatile, meaning that reads and writes to this field are atomic and writes are always made visible to other threads. If another thread reads the value of this field (e.g. through its accessor), it sees not only that value, but all side effects that led to writing that value.

name: kotlin.wasm.WasmExport
summary: Exports a function with the given optional name. The declaration name will be used if the name argument is not provided.

name: kotlin.wasm.WasmImport
summary: Imports a function from the given module with the given optional name. The declaration name will be used if the name argument is not provided.

name: kotlin.native.ref.WeakReference
summary: Class WeakReference encapsulates weak reference to an object, which could be used to either retrieve a strong reference to an object, or return null, if object was already destroyed by the memory manager.

name: kotlin.native.concurrent.Worker
summary: Class representing a worker.

name: kotlin.native.concurrent.WorkerBoundReference
summary: A shared reference to a Kotlin object that doesn't freeze the referred object when it gets frozen itself.
